description: Qualified standalone diskboot-2026-10-19-ffs-td64-frontend.1 ROM on Lightweight. PAL OCS, 68000, 512 KiB Chip + 512 KiB slow RAM, DD/HD DF0 and optional existing RDB/explicit FFS hard disk with TD64 offsets above 4 GiB. Choose the qualified ROM in Setup or use --copperstart --rom <path>. CopperOS is separate; old host CopperStart services remain unavailable.
